preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised owner account)
Bouns distribution must be active (bounsTime must be reached)

exploit_hint: As owner, call sumBounsPiece() with an extremely large number (e.g., type(uint256).max) for the current day's date string. This will set dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] to a value greater than dayPoolBouns[yesToday]. Then when any user calls receiveBounsToken(), the _sumCanGetToken() function will attempt to subtract dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday].mul(balancePiece) from dayPoolBouns[yesToday], causing a subtraction overflow revert due to SafeMath's require(b <= a) check. This permanently disables the bonus distribution mechanism.
